notes.title: The Game is updated, old version is still playable.
notes.content:
I have updated the game.

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42094739/1e495fcf766f50f911a4b32908fd1eb9c5ed4126.png[/img]

1. All light settings have been changed. Shadows have been turned on.
2. Minor changes were made to textures for better blending with the environment.
3. New visual effects. New Fog, Rainbow, etc. 
4. Character jump height has been increased.
5. Re-sculptured some cliffs. 

The original version of the game that I released on Jan 6th will not be removed, it is still available in the beta section. 

How to switch to the older original version of the game:

"To switch to a custom branch in the Steam client, right-click on the game from the library page and select "Properties". Among the available tabs will be the "BETAS" tab.
Your beta should be listed in the dropdown menu under "Select the beta you would like to opt into:"

See Jan 17th post for video instructions on how to use it.

notes.title: The new beta version of the game has been released with new illumination.
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42094739/f40833409d05f61c673cfbb82837deb7a31601b3.png[/img]The Beta version of the game has been released. Available to everyone who owns the game. 

1. All light settings have been changed. Shadows have been turned on. 
2. Minor changes were made to textures for better blending with the environment.
3. New visual effects.
4. Character jump height has been increased. 

The game should runs at same fps as before.

Feel free to let me know of any problems or give me suggestions on future updates. 

Is the sound too loud when you launch a new game? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42094739/98bc211370012f1c7fd57562a72f7e4e31750d1c.png[/img]

If you need help finding the beta:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Jz7bwXcaoFM

I apologize for the low quality of the video, not sure why it is blurry.
